texts.name: Some elements and designs have been blurred, redacted, or built from scratch to protect the privacy of my clients, employers, and co-workers. But all other details are authentic. With the exception of The Case Study I Wish Designers Would Show Me (which I created for this course)—everything in these resources is real and was actually presented by me to a client, an employer, or a hiring team during interviews. I included them here because I know they work.
